title: Humans in the Loop (Seb Agertoft) full episode — 'a battle for the soul of our economy'
summary: Seb Agertoft releases the full 53-minute Humans in the Loop episode with Eric on launch day, six weeks after announcing the booking. Eric opens cold with a frontlines framing — a battle for the soul of the economy that most builders haven't realized is happening.
blockquote: I've been at the front lines of a battle that most builders don't even know is going on. A battle for the soul of our economy.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Humans in the Loop
attribution_title: Coach & Advisor to Founders; Host, Humans in the Loop
